rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a large or impressive physical building or structure.

example.english: That edifice looks imposing after its lights come on at night.
example.traditional: 嗰座建築物夜晚亮燈之後好有氣勢。
example.jyutping: go2 zo6 gin3 zuk1 mat6 je6 maan5 loeng6 dang1 zi1 hau6 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3

rows.note: Use 架構 for the organization or framework of an argument, theory, or other abstract structure.

example.english: The edifice of your report is very clear, so readers can follow it easily.
example.traditional: 你份報告嘅架構好清晰，讀者好易跟。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 gaa3 gau3 hou2 cing1 sik1 duk6 ze2 hou2 ji6 gan1

rows.note: Use 體系 for a coherent system or school of thought rather than the internal framework of an argument.

example.english: This philosophical edifice became an important foundation of modern thought.
example.traditional: 呢套哲學體系成為現代思想嘅重要基礎。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 zit3 hok6 tai2 hai6 sing4 wai4 jin6 doi6 si1 soeng2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 gei1 co2
